name: 3-2-1 countdown prop reveal ("One, two, three. Let's see how it comes out")
status: PROVEN mechanic: 11 of 18 FB reels with a 3-2-1 VO cleared 50K (2.7M, 524K, 147K, 112K, 98K, 97K, 90K, 88K, MG 98K, MC 63.3K, MC 62.0K). It is a hook MECHANIC layered under a text family (don't-show, NEEDS, store, cut-off, POV), so its reels also count in those specs.
summary: Talent holds the product disguised as something else (folded on a baking tray, under a muffin tin, under a cloth) and counts '3, 2, 1… let's see how it comes out' in native AI audio, then flips/tosses/unveils the product on 'one'. The nonsense is the hook; the countdown gives the viewer a reason to stay to ~3 s.
why: FB hit rate with the VO: 11/18 ≥50K (61%) vs HJ base rate median ~59K (hooks_features vo_321 column).

Decisive condition: product visible at 0.0 s. Every 3-2-1 reel with product_pct_0 = 0 flopped (IG 9K, 3.3K, 1.1K; HJ 6.2K; MerryFires 3.1K; Merry Glows 457), while 11/15 with the product visible won (hook_features.csv product_pct_0).
2.7M (tray, 'One, two, three. Let's see how it comes out', loaf 35% of frame) and 524K (muffin tin, '3, 2, 1', 40%).
External: nocturne.robes0 'I made this for the Goths... 🥹' on a muffin-tin tray, 1.3M / 14.9K shares (X).

product_fit.type: Decor that can be held lit or boxed
product_fit.fit: YES if the product (lit) is visible at 0 s
product_fit.evidence: MC 63.3K / 62.0K (product 10%, lit curtain), MG 98K (box in hand 15%)

product_fit.type: Fire pit / anything that becomes an unreadable lump

timing.basis: VO occupies ~0-3.8 s (2.7M first cut 3.800; MC 63.3K hook runs to 5.000 with the VO). Song enters on the first body cut (2.7M Holly Jolly at ~3.8-4.0).

shots.content: talent holds tray/tin with the product legible; 'three' ~0.6 s, 'two' ~1.4 s, 'one' ~2.2 s, flip/toss on 'one'; 'let's see how it comes out' to ~3.4 s
talent slips the {product} on, turned away with her back to the phone, hood up so the hood design is what the phone sees
open it wide: white sherpa lining, step into the foot pouch (legs view); the B1→B2 boundary is the jump cut
macro: USB / power-bank clicks into the port in the fur
shots.text: JK flip lands exactly here on store hooks

shots.content: POV thumb presses the controller, LED heat levels climb
reclined on couch/bed, fully inside, hood up, eyes close / smile, tree lights behind; CUT MID-ACTION

measured: 2.7M: 3.800 | 6.033 | 10.100 | 10.633 | 11.467 | END 13.77 (VO + Holly Jolly from the first cut).
MC 63.3K (curtain): HOOK 0-5.000 | BOX -5.967 | INSTALL -7.367 | FACADE ×3 → END 12.15; 3s 44%, avg 7 s, drop-off 0:02.
rules: Reveal on 'one' by ≤2.6 s; first cut 2.6-3.9 s.
Native audio ON for H1 (Seedance generates the countdown voice); mute non-English drift.

text.style: House style. Text is the paired family's line, not the countdown (never caption the numbers).

patterns.pattern: DO NOT let your {mom} see this ❄️😳 (+ 3-2-1)
POV: the whole street is JEALOUS of your house.. 😏🏠 (+ 3-2-1)

rules: Pair with a family line that names a recipient or envy; 'For my Christmas Lovers' (5.9K) and 'A grinch heated blanket?' (6.2K) flopped.

picks.track: Native VO (0-~3.8 s) then Holly Jolly Christmas (Bublé) from its opening line

rules: Keep VO intelligible over music: duck music −8 to −10 dB until the first cut [I].

generation_plan.summary: 4 gens: H1 (720p, native audio ON, 3-4 rolls: countdown timing is the most failure-prone part), then the wearable body at 720p.
